en.title: PRU (Investment Firms) 1.3(10) and 6.1(2): which Chapter 6 rules apply to Externally Regulated firms
en.summary: Rule 1.3(10) says that "in Chapter 6, only Rule 6.6 applies" to Externally Regulated PRU Investment Firms. Rule 6.1(2) says "Other than Rules 6.5 and 6.6, this Chapter does not apply" to them, and Rule 6.5(2) contains a limitation written for them. Rule 6.5 carries the duty to notify a breach within one Business Day and the restriction on payments to Affiliates, so whether these firms are bound by it depends on which rule is read.
en.correction: Please align PRU INV 1.3(10) with 6.1(2) and 6.5(2) by addressing both Rules 6.5 and 6.6 expressly.
